subject: Re: Quick follow-up + EoQ timing for Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo recap + next steps

Hey Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we covered: live demo of Redwood inference runtime, expected latency/cost estimates for your 100 req/s baseline, KV caching options, and dedicated-hosting model for data isolation.
- As discussed, we can provision a 2-week pilot on a dedicated lane so you can validate latency and cost against your real workload.
- Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Slides.pdf (PDF, 3MB) and a draft SOW template for pilot scope (SOW_Template.docx).

Proposed next steps (feel free to edit):
1) I’ll share the draft SOW + pilot ops plan (attached).
2) Your team routes the SOW to procurement for budget/approval.
3) If procurement is good, we spin up the pilot the week after approval — engineering will need a 2-hour kickoff.

Can you confirm who on your side will own procurement/contracting, and whether the current target to start the pilot before the end of March is still realistic? I know EoQ is coming up for many teams.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call with procurement if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Demo slides attached: Redwood_Demo_Slides.pdf
SOW template attached: SOW_Template.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and the slides — very helpful. I’ve looped in procurement and legal (cc’d them on my internal thread) and asked them to review the SOW. I expect procurement to get back to me within 3–5 business days, but with EoQ there’s a chance it could be delayed.

I’ll follow up internally and let you know if they need anything from your side.

—Alex
Alex Johnson 
Head of Platforms, FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com | +1 212-555-0147

Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps (quick bump)

Alex —

Quick bump on this. With EoQ approaching I wanted to check whether procurement still has bandwidth to review the SOW this week or if the timeline shifted. If the decision is being delayed, totally understandable — if that’s the case can you share an updated target (e.g., still this week, next week, or after EoQ)?

If it helps, I can:
- Join a 20–30min sync with procurement/legal to walk through the SOW.
- Provide an abbreviated pilot SOW that shortens procurement review (2–3 pages).

We’re happy to be flexible on start date but want to make sure we surface any blockers early (budget, compliance review, or internal priorities).

Thanks for the heads up,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + EoQ timing for Redwood Inference

Hi Alex —

One more quick check as teams close out the quarter: has the priority or timing shifted on the pilot approval?

A couple of ways we can help move this forward before EoQ:
- Short pilot SOW (we can send a 1–page commitment) that reduces procurement review time.
- Fixed-cost pilot quote to avoid budget ambiguity.
- Quick 15-minute sync with your procurement lead — I’ll include our contracts manager, Laura Bennett, to answer any questions live.

If priorities have shifted to post-EoQ, no problem — just let us know so we can plan the Dedicated capacity window. If you’re still aiming for an EoQ kickoff, what would you need from us before Wednesday?

Appreciate the update.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
